title: USB VIP real class hierarchy and pragma-protect encryption map (Synopsys SVT USB VIP W-2025.03)
summary: Synopsys SVT USB VIP W-2025.03 (stamped at include/sverilog/svt_usb_defines.svi:57). src/sverilog has three IDENTICAL simulator-targeted trees (mti, ncv, vcs), each 458 svt_usb_*.sv files re-encrypted with a different `pragma protect` key; src/C, src/vera, src/gate, src/rtl are empty of USB content; src/verilog/mti holds only the older plain-Verilog 'nvs_*' BFM/channel library, not USB protocol source. Encryption is selective, not whole-file: class/endclass, typedef enum, public field declarations, Javadoc comments, and every 'extern virtual function'/'extern task' PROTOTYPE survive in cleartext; only method bodies/constraints are AES-encrypted pragma-protect blocks. Verified real hierarchy (class X extends Y, with exact file:line): svt_usb_configuration extends svt_configuration (svt_usb_configuration.sv:189); svt_usb_agent_configuration extends svt_usb_configuration (svt_usb_agent_configuration.sv:107, via macro SVT_USB_SUBENV_CONFIGURATION_TYPE); svt_usb_hub_agent_configuration extends svt_usb_configuration (svt_usb_hub_agent_configuration.sv:14); svt_usb_device_configuration (svt_usb_device_configuration.sv:27), svt_usb_host_configuration (svt_usb_host_configuration.sv:14), svt_usb_endpoint_configuration (svt_usb_endpoint_configuration.sv:19) are SIBLINGS extending svt_configuration directly, NOT children of svt_usb_agent_configuration. svt_usb_transaction (svt_usb_transaction.sv:268), svt_usb_transfer (svt_usb_transfer.sv:420), svt_usb_packet (svt_usb_packet.sv:39), svt_usb_protocol_service (svt_usb_protocol_service.sv:19), svt_usb_agent_service (svt_usb_agent_service.sv:25), svt_usb_xhci_trb (svt_usb_xhci_trb.sv:13) are ALL SIBLINGS directly extending the macro `SVT_TRANSACTION_TYPE (= svt_sequence_item under UVM/OVM [itself built on uvm_sequence_item via svt_sequence_item_base], or svt_transaction [built on vmm_data] under VMM -- macro defined in src/sverilog/mti/svt_transaction.sv:32-56) -- none of transfer/packet/transaction extend each other despite the layering intuition. svt_usb_payload extends `SVT_DATA_TYPE. svt_usb_link (svt_usb_link.sv:321), svt_usb_physical (svt_usb_physical.sv:488), svt_usb_protocol (svt_usb_protocol.sv:606) all extend svt_xactor directly (NOT svt_driver/svt_monitor) -- each is a combined active/passive dual-role engine, and the agent additionally instantiates a separate sibling _monitor class per layer (svt_usb_link_monitor, svt_usb_physical_monitor, svt_usb_protocol_monitor) regardless of active/passive mode. svt_usb_status extends svt_status (svt_usb_status.sv:36) -- this is the 'shared_status' runtime object. svt_usb_bus_instance, svt_usb_xhci_td, svt_usb_xhci_trb_ring also extend svt_status. svt_usb_agent (svt_usb_agent.sv:958, class name is macro SVT_USB_SUBENV_TYPE) extends svt_agent under UVM/OVM or svt_subenv under VMM. svt_usb_hub_agent (svt_usb_hub_agent.sv:32) extends a PARALLEL, separate macro-namespaced base (SVT_USB_HUB_SUBENV_SVT_TYPE), gated by `ifdef SVT_USB_ENABLE_HUB_MODE (compile-time opt-in, not always compiled in). svt_usb_virtual_sequencer and svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer both extend svt_sequencer. svt_usb_types (svt_usb_types.sv:276) is a bare namespace class -- does NOT extend anything -- holding ~90 typedef enum declarations shared VIP-wide. CORRECTION: no class named 'svt_usb_sequencer' exists anywhere in this VIP; that name should never be used to refer to the real sequencer layer (svt_usb_virtual_sequencer / svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer / the per-layer non-virtual sequencers). Cleartext fraction of key files (total lines -> clear lines): svt_usb_agent.sv 18091->520 (2.9%), svt_usb_protocol.sv 14058->702 (5.0%, almost fully encrypted -- endpoint/isoc scheduler internals NOT extractable from source), svt_usb_link.sv 7906->1498 (18.9%), svt_usb_physical.sv 9648->1944 (20.1%), svt_usb_configuration.sv 31667->12638 (39.9%), svt_usb_transaction.sv 7145->2428 (34.0%), svt_usb_packet.sv 20841->6594 (31.6%), svt_usb_status.sv 13566->5519 (40.7%), svt_usb_types.sv 6238->3877 (62.2%, highest fraction -- enums are rarely encrypted). svt_usb_virtual_sequencer.sv and svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer.sv are effectively 100% readable at the API level (every field and extern method prototype is cleartext; only method bodies at the file tail are encrypted). Sequence-collection files (~300 files under src/sverilog/mti, e.g. svt_usb_20_na_30_ss_transfer_system_virtual_sequence_collection.sv, 23086 lines) are 100% cleartext and were NOT explored in this pass -- flagged as the right target for a VIP-examples category extraction. Full detail, per-class field/method listings, and interface-layer detail live in the companion report file.
